verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's marketing page claims it can screen customers during onboarding, ongoing monitoring, or ad-hoc investigations, so it nominally offers a screening capability. But the evidence never mentions sanctions lists or watchlists, choosing specific lists, or screening companies as distinct from individuals. The Alerts API ingests alerts from external monitoring systems, which suggests screening may happen outside the product, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented sanctions/watchlist screening, selection of specific lists, coverage of both individuals and companies, first-party screening docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can screen individuals and companies against selected sanctions and watchlists

citations.quote: Screen customers and disposition alerts more intelligently. Streamline your onboarding, ongoing monitoring, or ad-hoc investigations using customizable automation
